title: Industrial Wastes And Industrial Water Treatment
modules: Industrial Wastes And Their Impact On The
Handling Of Wastes And Treatment Methods
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to dispose solid, liquid and gaseous wastes."
Incineration is used to dispose solid, liquid and gaseous wastes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most popular method of controlled cooling of water treatment."
Closed recirculation system is the most popular method of controlled cooling of water treatment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the methods of disposing wastes in waste management practice."
Recycling of wastes is one of the methods of disposing wastes in waste management practice.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in the management of organic wastes by controlling and accelerating the natural process of decomposing organic materials."
The biological decomposition is used in the management of organic wastes by controlling and accelerating the natural process of decomposing organic materials.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important way of managing wastes."
Reduction of wastes Reduction of wastes is an important way of managing wastes.
fib: ______ is the commonest recirculation water system that is used for cooling.
Closed system is the commonest recirculation water system that is used for cooling.
______ refers to the re-use of waste materials.
Recycling of wastes Recycling refers to the re-use of waste materials.
______ is used for heating under controlled conditions.
Boiler water system is used for heating under controlled conditions.
______ is used to control temperature in industry.
Closed recirculation water system is used to control temperature in industry.
